ApiKeyCreateRequest.title: ApiKeyCreateRequest

ApiKeyResponse.description:
One API key as listed. ``key`` is present ONLY in the create
response — the one moment the full key is ever shown.
ApiKeyResponse.title: ApiKeyResponse

CandidateCreateRequest.description: Draft a candidate for the review queue (stub, B-018).
CandidateCreateRequest.title: CandidateCreateRequest

CandidateResponse.description: A candidate as the queue shows it.
CandidateResponse.title: CandidateResponse

EmailChangeRequest.description:
Ask to move the account to a new email (B-020). The change
completes only when the token sent to the NEW address is used.
EmailChangeRequest.title: EmailChangeRequest

GroupCreateRequest.description: Create a group; the creator becomes its owner (B-015).
GroupCreateRequest.title: GroupCreateRequest

GroupResponse.description: A group as the API shows it.
GroupResponse.title: GroupResponse

HealthResponse.description: The first thing to check when "it doesn't work" (roadmap §5).
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

InviteRequest.description: Invite a person by email with a starting role (B-016).
InviteRequest.title: InviteRequest

JobResponse.description: A job's state as its enqueuer can poll it (B-008).
JobResponse.title: JobResponse

MagicLinkRequest.description: Ask for a sign-in link by email (B-012).

MembershipResponse.description: One membership row: who, with which role, in which state.
MembershipResponse.title: MembershipResponse

MetaResponse.description: Public facts about this deployment: name, version, contract.
MetaResponse.title: MetaResponse

PasswordChangeRequest.description: Set a new password, proving the current one (B-020).
PasswordChangeRequest.title: PasswordChangeRequest

RefreshRequest.description: Exchange a refresh token for a fresh session (B-013).
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

RegisterRequest.description: Create an account with email + password (B-011).
RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest

SeatCreateRequest.description:
Create an agent seat (B-018): a name, a role, and the scopes
its key will carry. Approval is never among a seat's powers.
SeatCreateRequest.title: SeatCreateRequest

SeatResponse.description: A seat as listed. ``key`` appears only at creation.
SeatResponse.title: SeatResponse

SessionResponse.description:
What a successful sign-in returns: short-lived access token,
rotating refresh token, and who it belongs to.
SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse

TokenConsumeRequest.description: Present a one-time token (magic link / reset / email change).
TokenConsumeRequest.title: TokenConsumeRequest

UserResponse.description: A person's public profile. Never carries any credential.
